answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 25335 Country: India Title: Will one who recited Quran in Arabic without understanding it get any reward? Question: Will one who recited Quran in Arabic without understanding it get any reward? Answer ID: 25335 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1499/1064/L=1431) It is mentioned in hadith that one gets reward on reciting the holy Quran whether one understands or not; hence if someone recites the holy Quran without understanding it, he or she shall get the reward. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
